- to pojedyncza linia w `showTab()`
- łatwo ją naprawić przez prosty warunek lub eksport do `window`

## Prosta poprawka

- `if (window.drawTray && window.KAL) drawTray(KAL.angle);`

  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const hasTarget = bands && isFinite(bands.targetMin) && isFinite(bands.targetMax);
  if (!hasTarget) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.6)';
    ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Brak ustawionego celu', w / 2, h / 2);
    return;
  }

  const target = (bands.targetMin + bands.targetMax) / 2;
  const toleranceHalf = Math.max((bands.targetMax - bands.targetMin) / 2, 0.1);

  const dev1 = isFinite(valDS1) ? (valDS1 - target) : 0;
  const dev2 = isFinite(valDS2) ? (valDS2 - target) : 0;
  const maxDev = Math.max(Math.abs(dev1), Math.abs(dev2), toleranceHalf * 1.4);
  const steps = [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0];
  const scaleMax = steps.find(s => s >= maxDev * 1.15) || steps[steps.length - 1];

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 46;
  const R = Math.min(w / 2 - 30, h - 90);

  const angleFor = (dev) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(-scaleMax, Math.min(scaleMax, dev));
    return (clamped / scaleMax) * (Math.PI / 2);
  };
  const pointFor = (dev, radius) => {
    const a = angleFor(dev) - Math.PI / 2;
    return { x: cx + radius * Math.cos(a), y: cy + radius * Math.sin(a) };
  };

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#444441';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();

  const tolA1 = angleFor(toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(29,158,117,.55)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, tolA0, tolA1);
  ctx.stroke();

  if (bands && isFinite(bands.alarmMin) && isFinite(bands.alarmMax)) {
    const alarmHalfLo = target - bands.alarmMin;
    const alarmHalfHi = bands.alarmMax - target;
    if (alarmHalfLo > toleranceHalf) {
      const a0 = angleFor(-alarmHalfLo) - Math.PI / 2;
      const a1 = angleFor(-toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(216,90,48,.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, a0, a1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    if (alarmHalfHi > toleranceHalf) {
      const a0 = angleFor(toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
      const a1 = angleFor(alarmHalfHi) - Math.PI / 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(216,90,48,.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, a0, a1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  const tickVals = [-scaleMax, -scaleMax / 2, 0, scaleMax / 2, scaleMax];
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888780';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5f5e5a';
  ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  tickVals.forEach(v => {
    const pOuter = pointFor(v, R + 4);
    const pInner = pointFor(v, R - 6);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pInner.x, pInner.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pOuter.x, pOuter.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    const pLabel = pointFor(v, R + 16);
    const sign = v > 0 ? '+' : '';
    ctx.fillText(v === 0 ? '0' : sign + v.toFixed(1), pLabel.x, pLabel.y + 3);
  });

  const drawNeedle = (dev, color, length, width) => {
    if (!isFinite(dev)) return;
    const tip = pointFor(dev, length);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  drawNeedle(dev2, '#378ADD', R - 22, 2);
  drawNeedle(dev1, '#D85A30', R - 10, 3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#444441';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2c2c2a';
  ctx.font = '10px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(target.toFixed(1) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx, cy - R - 12);

  ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#D85A30';
    ctx.fillText('DS1 ' + valDS1.toFixed(2) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx - R + 6, h - 18);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  if (isFinite(valDS2)) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#378ADD';
    ctx.fillText('DS2 ' + valDS2.toFixed(2) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx + R - 6, h - 18);
  }
}

function drawHistoryChart(canvasId, points2, opt) {
  const el = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!el) return;
  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = Math.max(280, Math.floor(rect.width || 320));
  const h = Math.max(140, Math.floor(rect.height || 180));

  el.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
  el.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const seriesDS1 = Array.isArray(points2) ? points2 : (points2?.ds1 || []);
  const seriesDS2 = Array.isArray(points2) ? null : (points2?.ds2 || null);

  const pad = { top: 26, bottom: 30, left: 46, right: 18 };
  const plotW = w - pad.left - pad.right;
  const plotH = h - pad.top - pad.bottom;

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  if (!seriesDS1 || seriesDS1.length < 2) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.6)';
    ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Czekanie na dane...', w / 2, h / 2);
    return;
  }

  const allPoints = seriesDS2 ? [...seriesDS1, ...seriesDS2] : seriesDS1;
  const values = allPoints.map(p => p.v).filter(isF);
  if (!values.length) return;

  let lo = Math.min(...values);
  let hi = Math.max(...values);
  if (opt.bands) {
    const b = opt.bands;
    const withBands = [b.targetMin, b.targetMax, b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax].filter(isF);
    if (withBands.length) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, ...withBands);
      hi = Math.max(hi, ...withBands);
    }
  }

  const span = Math.max(0.5, hi - lo);
  const margin = Math.max(span * 0.15, opt.metric === 'humidity' ? 2 : 0.3);
  lo -= margin;
  hi += margin;

  const tMin = seriesDS1[0].ts;
  const tMax = Math.max(seriesDS1.at(-1).ts, tMin + 1);

  const mapX = (ts) => pad.left + ((ts - tMin) / (tMax - tMin)) * plotW;
  const mapY = (v) => pad.top + plotH - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * plotH;

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(138,132,112,.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  const gridStepX = plotW / 10;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
    const x = pad.left + gridStepX * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, pad.top);
    ctx.lineTo(x, pad.top + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  const gridLines = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i <= gridLines; i++) {
    const y = pad.top + (plotH / gridLines) * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y);
    ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, y);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.85)';
    ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const label = (opt.metric === 'humidity') ? val.toFixed(0) + '%' : val.toFixed(1) + '°';
    ctx.fillText(label, pad.left - 6, y);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

  if (opt.bands) {
    const b = opt.bands;
    if (isFinite(b.alarmMin) && isFinite(b.alarmMax)) {
      const yTop = mapY(Math.max(b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax));
      const yBottom = mapY(Math.min(b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239,68,68,.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(pad.left, yTop, plotW, Math.max(1, yBottom - yTop));
    }
    if (isFinite(b.targetMin) && isFinite(b.targetMax)) {
      const yTop = mapY(Math.max(b.targetMin, b.targetMax));
      const yBottom = mapY(Math.min(b.targetMin, b.targetMax));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(29,158,117,.14)';
      ctx.fillRect(pad.left, yTop, plotW, Math.max(1, yBottom - yTop));

      const mid = (b.targetMin + b.targetMax) / 2;
      const yMid = mapY(mid);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(15,110,86,.7)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pad.left, yMid);
      ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, yMid);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
  }

  const drawTrace = (points, color) => {
    if (!points || points.length < 2) return;
    ctx.beginPath();
    points.forEach((p, i) => {
      const x = mapX(p.ts);
      const y = mapY(p.v);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    });
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  drawTrace(seriesDS1, '#D85A30');
  drawTrace(seriesDS2, '#378ADD');

  const drawHead = (points, color) => {
    const last = points?.at(-1);
    if (!last || !isFinite(last.v)) return;
    const x = mapX(last.ts);
    const y = mapY(last.v);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 3.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
  };
  drawHead(seriesDS1, '#D85A30');
  drawHead(seriesDS2, '#378ADD');

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74,27,12,.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(w - pad.right, pad.top);
  ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, pad.top + plotH);
  ctx.stroke();

  const labelsCount = 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.85)';
  ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  for (let i = 0; i <= labelsCount; i++) {
    const t = tMin + (tMax - tMin) * (i / labelsCount);
    const x = mapX(t);
    const d = new Date(t);
    const label = (tMax - tMin < 3600000)
      ? d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
      : d.toLocaleString('pl-PL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
    ctx.fillText(label, x, pad.top + plotH + 6);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

  ctx.font = '10px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#D85A30';
  ctx.fillRect(pad.left, 6, 10, 3);
  ctx.fillText('DS1', pad.left + 14, 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#378ADD';
  ctx.fillRect(pad.left + 50, 6, 10, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5f5e5a';
  ctx.fillText('DS2', pad.left + 64, 13);
}

  if(!el) return;
  const ctx=el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const w=Math.max(260,Math.floor(el.clientWidth||el.offsetWidth||260));
  const h=Math.max(80,Math.floor(el.clientHeight||120));
  if(el.width!==Math.floor(w*dpr) || el.height!==Math.floor(h*dpr)){
    el.width=Math.floor(w*dpr);
    el.height=Math.floor(h*dpr);
  }
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const pad=10;
  const plotW=w-2*pad;
  const plotH=h-2*pad;
  if(!points || points.length<2){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.6)';
    ctx.font='11px IBM Plex Mono';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(points?.length?'Za mało danych':'Czekanie na dane...',Math.floor(w/2),Math.floor(h/2));
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    return;
  }
  const values=points.map(p=>p.v).filter(isF);
  if(!values.length){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.6)';
    ctx.font='11px IBM Plex Mono';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('Brak prawidłowych danych', Math.floor(w/2), Math.floor(h/2));
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    return;
  }
  let lo=Math.min(...values);
  let hi=Math.max(...values);
  if(opt.bands){
    const b=opt.bands;
    const withBands=[b.targetMin,b.targetMax,b.alarmMin,b.alarmMax].filter(isF);
    if(withBands.length){ lo=Math.min(lo,...withBands); hi=Math.max(hi,...withBands); }
  }
  const span=Math.max(0.5,hi-lo);
  const margin=Math.max(span*0.15,opt.metric==='humidity'?2:0.3);
  lo-=margin; hi+=margin;
  const tMin=points[0].ts;
  const tMax=Math.max(points[points.length-1].ts,tMin+1);
  const mapX=(ts)=>pad+((ts-tMin)/(tMax-tMin))*plotW;
  const mapY=(v)=>pad+plotH-((v-lo)/(hi-lo))*plotH;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const y=pad+(plotH/3)*i;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,y); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  if(opt.bands && chartState.showBands){
    // pas alarmowy — delikatna czerwień w tle
    drawBand(ctx,mapY,opt.bands.alarmMin,opt.bands.alarmMax,'rgba(239,68,68,.07)',w,pad);
    // pas docelowy — zielony
    drawBand(ctx,mapY,opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax,'rgba(34,197,94,.18)',w,pad);
    // obramowanie pasa docelowego
    const ytop=mapY(Math.max(opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax));
    const ybot=mapY(Math.min(opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax));
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,ytop); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ytop); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,ybot); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ybot); ctx.stroke();
    // linia celu (środek pasa) — przerywana zielona
    const mid=(opt.bands.targetMin+opt.bands.targetMax)/2;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,mapY(mid)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,mapY(mid)); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }
  const latest=points[points.length-1]?.v;
  // linia danych — zawsze jasnoniebieski (niezależnie od odchylenia)
  ctx.beginPath();
  points.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const x=mapX(p.ts), y=mapY(p.v);
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle='#7dd3fc';
  ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
  ctx.lineJoin='round';
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.stroke();
  // wartość aktualna — kolor dynamiczny (status)
  const statusColor=getStatusColor(latest,opt.bands);
  ctx.fillStyle=statusColor;
  ctx.font='bold 11px IBM Plex Mono';
  ctx.fillText((isF(latest)?latest.toFixed(1):'--')+' '+opt.unit,w-86,pad+12);
}
]]

function drawNullMeter(canvasId, valDS1, valDS2, bands, opt = {}) {
  const el = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!el) return;

  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = Math.max(220, Math.floor(rect.width || 260));
  const h = Math.max(160, Math.floor(rect.height || 180));

  el.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
  el.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const hasTarget = bands && isFinite(bands.targetMin) && isFinite(bands.targetMax);
  if (!hasTarget) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.6)';
    ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Brak ustawionego celu', w / 2, h / 2);
    return;
  }

  const target = (bands.targetMin + bands.targetMax) / 2;
  const toleranceHalf = Math.max((bands.targetMax - bands.targetMin) / 2, 0.1);

  const dev1 = isFinite(valDS1) ? (valDS1 - target) : 0;
  const dev2 = isFinite(valDS2) ? (valDS2 - target) : 0;
  const maxDev = Math.max(Math.abs(dev1), Math.abs(dev2), toleranceHalf * 1.4);
  const steps = [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0];
  const scaleMax = steps.find(s => s >= maxDev * 1.15) || steps[steps.length - 1];

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 46;
  const R = Math.min(w / 2 - 30, h - 90);

  const angleFor = (dev) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(-scaleMax, Math.min(scaleMax, dev));
    return (clamped / scaleMax) * (Math.PI / 2);
  };
  const pointFor = (dev, radius) => {
    const a = angleFor(dev) - Math.PI / 2;
    return { x: cx + radius * Math.cos(a), y: cy + radius * Math.sin(a) };
  };

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#444441';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();

  const tolA0 = angleFor(-toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
  const tolA1 = angleFor(toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(29,158,117,.55)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, tolA0, tolA1);
  ctx.stroke();

  if (bands && isFinite(bands.alarmMin) && isFinite(bands.alarmMax)) {
    const alarmHalfLo = target - bands.alarmMin;
    const alarmHalfHi = bands.alarmMax - target;
    if (alarmHalfLo > toleranceHalf) {
      const a0 = angleFor(-alarmHalfLo) - Math.PI / 2;
      const a1 = angleFor(-toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(216,90,48,.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, a0, a1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    if (alarmHalfHi > toleranceHalf) {
      const a0 = angleFor(toleranceHalf) - Math.PI / 2;
      const a1 = angleFor(alarmHalfHi) - Math.PI / 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(216,90,48,.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - 14, a0, a1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  const tickVals = [-scaleMax, -scaleMax / 2, 0, scaleMax / 2, scaleMax];
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888780';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5f5e5a';
  ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  tickVals.forEach(v => {
    const pOuter = pointFor(v, R + 4);
    const pInner = pointFor(v, R - 6);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pInner.x, pInner.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pOuter.x, pOuter.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    const pLabel = pointFor(v, R + 16);
    const sign = v > 0 ? '+' : '';
    ctx.fillText(v === 0 ? '0' : sign + v.toFixed(1), pLabel.x, pLabel.y + 3);
  });

  const drawNeedle = (dev, color, length, width) => {
    if (!isFinite(dev)) return;
    const tip = pointFor(dev, length);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  drawNeedle(dev2, '#378ADD', R - 22, 2);
  drawNeedle(dev1, '#D85A30', R - 10, 3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#444441';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2c2c2a';
  ctx.font = '10px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(target.toFixed(1) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx, cy - R - 12);

  ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  if (isFinite(valDS1)) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#D85A30';
    ctx.fillText('DS1 ' + valDS1.toFixed(2) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx - R + 6, h - 18);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  if (isFinite(valDS2)) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#378ADD';
    ctx.fillText('DS2 ' + valDS2.toFixed(2) + (opt.unit || '°C'), cx + R - 6, h - 18);
  }
}

function drawHistoryChart(canvasId, points2, opt) {
  const el = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!el) return;

  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = Math.max(280, Math.floor(rect.width || 320));
  const h = Math.max(140, Math.floor(rect.height || 180));

  el.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
  el.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const seriesDS1 = Array.isArray(points2) ? points2 : (points2?.ds1 || []);
  const seriesDS2 = Array.isArray(points2) ? null : (points2?.ds2 || null);

  const pad = { top: 26, bottom: 30, left: 46, right: 18 };
  const plotW = w - pad.left - pad.right;
  const plotH = h - pad.top - pad.bottom;

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f1e6';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  if (!seriesDS1 || seriesDS1.length < 2) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.6)';
    ctx.font = '11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Czekanie na dane...', w / 2, h / 2);
    return;
  }

  const allPoints = seriesDS2 ? [...seriesDS1, ...seriesDS2] : seriesDS1;
  const values = allPoints.map(p => p.v).filter(isF);
  if (!values.length) return;

  let lo = Math.min(...values);
  let hi = Math.max(...values);
  if (opt.bands) {
    const b = opt.bands;
    const withBands = [b.targetMin, b.targetMax, b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax].filter(isF);
    if (withBands.length) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, ...withBands);
      hi = Math.max(hi, ...withBands);
    }
  }

  const span = Math.max(0.5, hi - lo);
  const margin = Math.max(span * 0.15, opt.metric === 'humidity' ? 2 : 0.3);
  lo -= margin;
  hi += margin;

  const tMin = seriesDS1[0].ts;
  const tMax = Math.max(seriesDS1.at(-1).ts, tMin + 1);

  const mapX = (t) => pad.left + ((t - tMin) / (tMax - tMin)) * plotW;
  const mapY = (v) => pad.top + plotH - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * plotH;

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(138,132,112,.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  const gridStepX = plotW / 10;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
    const x = pad.left + gridStepX * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, pad.top);
    ctx.lineTo(x, pad.top + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  const gridLines = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i <= gridLines; i++) {
    const y = pad.top + (plotH / gridLines) * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y);
    ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, y);
    ctx.stroke();

    const val = lo + (hi - lo) * (1 - i / gridLines);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.85)';
    ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const label = (opt.metric === 'humidity') ? val.toFixed(0) + '%' : val.toFixed(1) + '°';
    ctx.fillText(label, pad.left - 6, y);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

  if (opt.bands) {
    const b = opt.bands;
    if (isFinite(b.alarmMin) && isFinite(b.alarmMax)) {
      const yTop = mapY(Math.max(b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax));
      const yBottom = mapY(Math.min(b.alarmMin, b.alarmMax));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239,68,68,.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(pad.left, yTop, plotW, Math.max(1, yBottom - yTop));
    }
    if (isFinite(b.targetMin) && isFinite(b.targetMax)) {
      const yTop = mapY(Math.max(b.targetMin, b.targetMax));
      const yBottom = mapY(Math.min(b.targetMin, b.targetMax));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(29,158,117,.14)';
      ctx.fillRect(pad.left, yTop, plotW, Math.max(1, yBottom - yTop));
      const mid = (b.targetMin + b.targetMax) / 2;
      const yMid = mapY(mid);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(15,110,86,.7)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pad.left, yMid);
      ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, yMid);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
  }

  const drawTrace = (points, color) => {
    if (!points || points.length < 2) return;
    ctx.beginPath();
    points.forEach((p, i) => {
      const x = mapX(p.ts);
      const y = mapY(p.v);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    });
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  drawTrace(seriesDS1, '#D85A30');
  drawTrace(seriesDS2, '#378ADD');

  const drawHead = (points, color) => {
    const last = points?.at(-1);
    if (!last || !isFinite(last.v)) return;
    const x = mapX(last.ts);
    const y = mapY(last.v);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 3.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
  };
  drawHead(seriesDS1, '#D85A30');
  drawHead(seriesDS2, '#378ADD');

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74,27,12,.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(w - pad.right, pad.top);
  ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, pad.top + plotH);
  ctx.stroke();

  const labelsCount = 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,94,90,.85)';
  ctx.font = '9px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  for (let i = 0; i <= labelsCount; i++) {
    const t = tMin + (tMax - tMin) * (i / labelsCount);
    const x = mapX(t);
    const d = new Date(t);
    const label = (tMax - tMin < 3600000)
      ? d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
      : d.toLocaleString('pl-PL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
    ctx.fillText(label, x, pad.top + plotH + 6);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

  ctx.font = '10px IBM Plex Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#D85A30';
  ctx.fillRect(pad.left, 6, 10, 3);
  ctx.fillText('DS1', pad.left + 14, 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#378ADD';
  ctx.fillRect(pad.left + 50, 6, 10, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5f5e5a';
  ctx.fillText('DS2', pad.left + 64, 13);
}

```
function drawHistoryChart(canvasId,points,opt){
  const el=document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if(!el) return;
  const ctx=el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const w=Math.max(260,Math.floor(el.clientWidth||el.offsetWidth||260));
  const h=Math.max(80,Math.floor(el.clientHeight||120));
  if(el.width!==Math.floor(w*dpr) || el.height!==Math.floor(h*dpr)){
    el.width=Math.floor(w*dpr);
    el.height=Math.floor(h*dpr);
  }
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const pad=10;
  const plotW=w-2*pad;
  const plotH=h-2*pad;
  if(!points || points.length<2){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.6)';
    ctx.font='11px IBM Plex Mono';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(points?.length?'Za mało danych':'Czekanie na dane...',Math.floor(w/2),Math.floor(h/2));
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    return;
  }
  const values=points.map(p=>p.v).filter(isF);
  if(!values.length){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.6)';
    ctx.font='11px IBM Plex Mono';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('Brak prawidłowych danych', Math.floor(w/2), Math.floor(h/2));
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    return;
  }
  let lo=Math.min(...values);
  let hi=Math.max(...values);
  if(!isFinite(lo) || !isFinite(hi)) return;
  if(opt.bands){
    const b=opt.bands;
    const withBands=[b.targetMin,b.targetMax,b.alarmMin,b.alarmMax].filter(isF);
    if(withBands.length){ lo=Math.min(lo,...withBands); hi=Math.max(hi,...withBands); }
  }
  const span=Math.max(0.5,hi-lo);
  const margin=Math.max(span*0.15,opt.metric==='humidity'?2:0.3);
  lo-=margin; hi+=margin;
  const tMin=points[0].ts;
  const tMax=Math.max(points[points.length-1].ts,tMin+1);
  const mapX=(ts)=>pad+((ts-tMin)/(tMax-tMin))*plotW;
  const mapY=(v)=>pad+plotH-((v-lo)/(hi-lo))*plotH;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const y=pad+(plotH/3)*i;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(136,145,170,.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,y); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  if(opt.bands && chartState.showBands){
    // pas alarmowy — delikatna czerwień w tle
    drawBand(ctx,mapY,opt.bands.alarmMin,opt.bands.alarmMax,'rgba(239,68,68,.07)',w,pad);
    // pas docelowy — zielony
    drawBand(ctx,mapY,opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax,'rgba(34,197,94,.18)',w,pad);
    // obramowanie pasa docelowego
    const ytop=mapY(Math.max(opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax));
    const ybot=mapY(Math.min(opt.bands.targetMin,opt.bands.targetMax));
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,ytop); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ytop); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,ybot); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ybot); ctx.stroke();
    // linia celu (środek pasa) — przerywana zielona
    const mid=(opt.bands.targetMin+opt.bands.targetMax)/2;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,mapY(mid)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,mapY(mid)); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }
  const latest=points[points.length-1]?.v;
  // linia danych — zawsze jasnoniebieski (niezależnie od odchylenia)
  ctx.beginPath();
  points.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const x=mapX(p.ts), y=mapY(p.v);
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle='#7dd3fc';
  ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
  ctx.lineJoin='round';
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.stroke();
  // wartość aktualna — kolor dynamiczny (status)
  const statusColor=getStatusColor(latest,opt.bands);
  ctx.fillStyle=statusColor;
  ctx.font='bold 11px IBM Plex Mono';
  ctx.fillText((isF(latest)?latest.toFixed(1):'--')+' '+opt.unit,w-86,pad+12);
}

function formatSigned(value, decimals = 2) {
  if (!isF(value)) return '--';
  return (value >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(value).toFixed(decimals);
}

function updateHeaterBar(fillId, valId, tickId, raw) {
  const clamped = normalizeHeaterPwmValue(raw);
  const pct = isFinite(clamped) ? Math.round((clamped / MAX_HEATER_RAW) * 100) : 0;
  const fill = document.getElementById(fillId);
  const val = document.getElementById(valId);
  const tick = document.getElementById(tickId);
  if (fill) fill.style.width = pct + '%';
  if (val) val.textContent = isFinite(clamped) ? String(clamped) : '--';
  if (tick) tick.style.left = pct + '%';
}

  const s = chartState.lastStatus;
  const tempMain = getMainSeries('temp_chamber', chartState.tempRange);
  const tempAquariumMain = getMainSeries('temp_aquarium', chartState.tempRange);
  const tempDetail = getDetailSeries('temp_chamber');
  const humMain = getMainSeries('humidity', chartState.humRange);
  const humDetail = getDetailSeries('humidity');

  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-main', {ds1: tempMain, ds2: tempAquariumMain}, {metric:'temp_chamber',unit:'°C',bands:getBands('temp_chamber',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-detail', tempDetail, {metric:'temp_chamber',unit:'°C',bands:getBands('temp_chamber',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-main', humMain, {metric:'humidity',unit:'%',bands:getBands('humidity',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-detail', humDetail, {metric:'humidity',unit:'%',bands:getBands('humidity',s)});

  const ds1 = tempMain.at(-1)?.v;
  const ds2 = tempAquariumMain.at(-1)?.v;
  const target = s?.target_temp;
  setText('odo-balance-temp', isFinite(ds1) && isFinite(target) ? formatSigned(ds1 - target, 2) : '--');
  setText('odo-diff-temp', isFinite(ds1) && isFinite(ds2) ? formatSigned(ds1 - ds2, 2) : '--');

  updateHeaterBar('heater-fill-0', 'heater-val-0', 'heater-tick-0', s?.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0);

}

  const s = chartState.lastStatus;
  const tempMain = getMainSeries('temp_chamber', chartState.tempRange);
  const tempAquariumMain = getMainSeries('temp_aquarium', chartState.tempRange);
  const tempDetail = getDetailSeries('temp_chamber');
  const humMain = getMainSeries('humidity', chartState.humRange);
  const humDetail = getDetailSeries('humidity');
  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-main', {ds1: tempMain, ds2: tempAquariumMain}, {metric:'temp_chamber', unit:'°C', bands:getBands('temp_chamber', s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-detail', tempDetail, {metric:'temp_chamber', unit:'°C', bands:getBands('temp_chamber', s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-main', humMain, {metric:'humidity', unit:'%', bands:getBands('humidity', s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-detail', humDetail, {metric:'humidity', unit:'%', bands:getBands('humidity', s)});

  const ds1 = tempMain.at(-1)?.v;
  const ds2 = tempAquariumMain.at(-1)?.v;
  const target = s?.target_temp;
  setText('odo-balance-temp', isFinite(ds1) && isFinite(target) ? formatSigned(ds1 - target, 2) : '--');
  setText('odo-diff-temp', isFinite(ds1) && isFinite(ds2) ? formatSigned(ds1 - ds2, 2) : '--');

  updateHeaterBar('heater-fill-0', 'heater-val-0', 'heater-tick-0', s?.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0);
  updateHeaterBar('heater-fill-1', 'heater-val-1', 'heater-tick-1', s?.heater_pwm_ch1 ?? 0);
}
